At β = 8 the better one recovers, after a median of 460 rounds. The scored control at β = 100 entrenches no one. Code: scratch/formal/trust_loop.py. | Active |

| [CASE-216](../../../record/cases.d/CASE-216.md) v2 | A four-state annealing toy, unfolded, nucleus, folded and a misfold trap, with free energies and transition states linear in temperature: the fraction folded at one hour peaks at 90.4 % at 318.6 K among constant temperatures, at sixteen hours it is at least 90 % from 313 to 323.5 K, and five minutes at 327 K followed by 318 K leaves 98.5 % folded at the hour, which no constant temperature does; the chance of having reached the folded state agrees to four places | The assistant's, on the owner's request of 2026-11-05 to connect the record's inquiry to DNA origami.
